verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs state it lets you "Manage your local models, prompts, and configurations" (docs-6), which matches the story directly. Supporting evidence covers in-app model search and download (docs-4, docs-17), per-load configuration such as GPU offload and context length (docs-13), and community mentions of the model catalog and the eject/unload control (comm-4, comm-19). missing for 10: detailed docs on saved-prompt management, documentation of persistent per-model configuration presets, and hands-on corroboration that these are managed together in one place.
